name: Stablecorp QCAD
oneLiner: QCAD is Stablecorp's Canadian dollar stablecoin redeemable 1:1 against CAD fiat in regulated Canadian banks under the QCAD Digital Trust framework.
collateral: Canadian dollars held 1:1 in regulated Canadian financial institutions under the QCAD Digital Trust reserve framework
pegMechanism: Qualified holders can mint and redeem QCAD at 1 CAD through Stablecorp or authorized partners; issuer APIs publish live supply and fiat reserve totals.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Stablecorp describes QCAD as a compliant CAD token and has issuer/public-regulatory evidence for multichain availability. No separate bridge protocol was resolved, so the reviewed route is issuer-native issuance on supported chains.

jurisdiction.license: FINTRAC MSB M22234558; QCAD Digital Trust VRCA framework

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: QCAD resolves to Yes because existing metadata classifies the asset as centralized and no manual override narrows that status.

mintAuthority.summary: QCAD token owner on both Ethereum and Base is a 6-of-6 Gnosis Safe (threshold 3) at 0x4ff9ace9. The proxy-admin on both chains is a separate 6-signer multisig (threshold 3, same signers) at different addresses. No modules or guards are enabled on either multisig. Stablecorp's issuance backend mints through the Safe-controlled token contract.

controls.label: Stablecorp issuance backend (servicer to QCAD Digital Trust)
controls.evidence: Stablecorp (FINTRAC MSB) administers the QCAD Program as servicer; authorized dealers/qualified holders mint QCAD 1:1 on CAD deposit and redeem at par against trust-held reserves, so Stablecorp controls supply creation.

controls.label: Stablecorp token owner — Gnosis Safe (6 signers, threshold 3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295037, owner() on QCAD ETH proxy 0x3fa142dd returned 0x4ff9ace93dd7a18bd7014aa9a179117adf20f6a9. getOwners() returned 6 addresses; getThreshold() = 3; VERSION() = '1.4.1'; getModulesPaginated returned empty array; guard storage slot = 0x0; fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732dc. Same Safe is owner on Base (confirmed via owner() at Base block 47200812).

controls.label: Proxy-admin upgrade authority — Ethereum and Base
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295037, EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot on QCAD ETH = 0xcf09e8de...; owner() on that ProxyAdmin = 0x6c4c5c74 (contract, 344 bytes). getOwners() on 0x6c4c5c returned the same 6 addresses as the token owner Safe; getThreshold() = 3; getModulesPaginated returned empty array. Same proxy-admin owner on Base (confirmed at Base block 47200812). This is a separate legacy multisig from the token owner Safe.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25295037, Base block 47200812: QCAD token owner on both chains = Gnosis Safe 0x4ff9ace9 (6 owners, threshold 3, VERSION 1.4.1, no modules, no guard). Proxy-admin on both chains owned by separate legacy multisig 0x6c4c5c (same 6 signers, threshold 3, no modules). All mint-capable on-chain surfaces resolved.
